record.reason: FlashVGGT compresses descriptors for visual geometry attention and reports 10.1x speedup and 15.8x fewer FLOPs on 1,000 images, with lower memory. The result is 3D vision-specific and does not evaluate LLM inference.
record.title: FlashVGGT: Efficient and Scalable Visual Geometry Transformers with Compressed Descriptor Attention
